title: Resort Vibes | Heated Pool, Hot Tub & Arcade Fun
description:
If you’re seeking a perfectly located home close to everything, this is it! Just 20 minutes from Old Town Scottsdale, PHX Airport, and Bell Bank Park, this dream retreat offers easy access to Scottsdale's premier shopping and dining, Gilbert’s family-friendly attractions, and the excitement of spring training baseball. Whether you’re planning a luxurious family gathering, a business retreat, a golf trip, or a relaxing escape, this stunning property has everything for an unforgettable stay.

 The space 
Escape the ordinary and step into your own private paradise at this unforgettable 6-bedroom jungle-themed retreat! This ideally located sprawling oasis blends the lush vibes of the tropics with all the modern comforts and entertainment you need for the ultimate group getaway.

🏡 The Home
Designed for families, friends, and groups of up to 20, this home features six spacious bedrooms (five king bedrooms plus a bunk room with two full-over-full bunks) and plenty of extra sleeping space (queen air mattress + pack ‘n play). Everyone gets room to spread out while still being together.

🎉 Endless Entertainment
This retreat was built for fun. Spend your days soaking up the sun and your nights making memories under the stars:
💦 Pool & Jacuzzi – Swim, float, or soak the stress away.
⛳ Putting Green – Perfect your short game between adventures.
🏓 Ping Pong & Cornhole – Challenge friends to some friendly competition.
🎱 Pool Table – Host a billiards showdown indoors.
👾 Classic Arcade Games – Mrs. Pac-Man & Ninja Turtles for nostalgia and kids’ excitement.
🔥 Fire Pit – Cozy up, share stories, and stargaze.
🍔 BBQ Grill & Outdoor Dining – Bring the whole group together for al fresco meals.

✨ Why You’ll Love It
Whether you’re planning a family reunion, a milestone celebration, a friends’ weekend, or just a well-deserved escape, this home checks every box:
Spacious Layout – Room for everyone without feeling crowded.
Social Media-Worthy Jungle Décor – A unique, photo-ready backdrop for your stay.
Resort-Style Amenities – All the fun of a vacation resort with the privacy of your own home.
Unbeatable Location – Quick drive to downtown dining, shopping, and nightlife.

🌙 The Perfect End to Your Day
After a day of wine tasting, hiking, or poolside lounging, gather your group around the fire pit, sip your favorite drink, and let the desert stars put on a show. This is more than just a vacation rental — it’s where memories are made.

Bedroom Layout:
• Bedroom 1: King Bed, Ensuite Bathroom, TV
• Bedroom 2: King Bed, TV
• Bedroom 3: King Bed
• Bedroom 4: King Bed
• Bedroom 5: King Bed
• Bedroom 6: Two Bunk Beds, Four Full Mattresses, TV
• Extra Sleeping: Queen-Sized Air Mattress and Pack-n-Play

Bathrooms: 3

 Guest access 
Our guests have full access to this home during their stay. We only ask that you refrain from removing or tampering with pool equipment to ensure no damage and the pool will remain clean during your stay. The home is keyless entry for a smooth check-in both afternoon and night!

 Other things to note 
The Neighborhood:
This stunning North Mesa neighborhood is truly one of a kind, offering a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Our neighbors are more than just neighbors—they’re our friends, and we value the strong sense of community here. We're thrilled to share our home with our guests and kindly ask that everyone respects the quiet hours from 10 PM to 7 AM. By doing so, we can continue providing a wonderful experience for our guests while preserving the harmony of this exceptional neighborhood.

Getting Around:
We love how easily accessible our home is, with Uber and Lyft available for guests who prefer not to rent a car or drive during their family vacation. Our concierge team is always ready to help you explore the best of Phoenix, Scottsdale, and the surrounding areas. For those seeking a quieter getaway or who prefer to plan independently, we’ve got you covered with comprehensive digital guidebooks filled with great local tips and recommendations!

1. Early Check-In - $200 (when available)
2. Late Check-Out - $200 (when available)
3. Daily Housekeeping - $175 for two hours. *Includes bathrooms, beds (sheet and towel change upon advance request), kitchen, and common living spaces. Please submit any special requests in advance.
4. Pet Cleaning and Deodorizing (dogs only) - $125 per pet for the duration of your stay.

In-home Concierge Services:

**Please contact us at least 1 week prior to your stay for any special occasions (birthdays, anniversaries, Bachelor(ette) stays, etc) 

1. Grocery Delivery 
2. Private Chef 
3. Electronics/Consumer Goods 
4. Private In-Home Massage 
5. Baby Equipment Rental

How The Home Is Stocked:
This home is fully furnished and stocked with a starter amount of essentials to get you going on your trip! Please plan accordingly to purchase enough additional consumables to last for the remainder of your stay.

All of our properties offer a variety of amenities, for which this home offers the following:
• Toaster, Microwave, Blender, Cooking Essentials, Silverware, Plates, Bowls, Glassware
• Drip Coffee Maker, Keurig Machine
• Dishwasher, Dishwasher Detergent
• Washer, Dryer, Clothing Detergent, Iron, Ironing Board
• Shampoo, Conditioner, Body Wash, Hair Dryer in each Bathroom
• Bed Linens, Pillows, Blankets, Bath & Pool Towels
• Outdoor Gas Grill (propane provided)
• Queen Air Mattress, Pack N Play, Booster/High Chair

The following items we do NOT provide:
• Condiments, Pressure Cookers, Crockpots, Bottled or Filtered Water
• Ice Maker
• Speakers or Stereo

House Rules & Notes:
• No parties or events of any kind allowed on property
• No more than 4 cars at the house at any time
• Must be 25 years of age or older to rent. Renting person must stay in the home throughout the reservation.
• No smoking
• Check-in time is 4 PM (this time is strict)
• Check-out time is 10 AM (this time is strict)
• Early check-in and late check-out (if available fees apply)
• Pets are allowed with exceptions (pet fees apply)

Due To A New City Ordinance:
• All reservations will go through a verification process
• Please be sure your full name is entered on your reservation when booking
• IDs will be requested for verification after booking
• We report and prosecute all credit card fraud

Other things to note
Maximum Occupancy. The number of people (including children) present at the Property may not exceed the maximum occupancy set forth in the Property Description.

This is a dog friendly property, there is a non-refundable pet fee (plus tax) per pet (limit 2), per stay. Dogs Only. Please keep your pup off the furniture (including the couches, chairs, and beds) and pick-up after your pup.
Please be sure to clean up after your pets to avoid additional charges.

We do have members of our team who may visit the property during your stay. They include landscaping and pool maintenance crews. These visits cannot be rescheduled or delayed.

Minimum Age. You must be at least 25 years of age to rent the Property. You hereby confirm that you are at least 25 years of age. You acknowledge that failure of this confirmation to be true constitutes a material breach of this Agreement.
